name: Downstream
objectiveText: Collect the Waterlogged Axe , Waterlogged Saw , and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford . Waterlogged Axe  ( 1 ) Waterlogged Saw  ( 1 ) Waterlogged Toolbox  ( 1 )

comments.body:
The 3 items is down stream from the bridge. Follow the River on the left side for best view of the items and less mobs.

First you will find the SAW at /way 74.3, 76.3
- by the big rock & riverplants

Second is the AXE at /way 76.8, 82.4
- Its on the island where the river splits.

Third is the toolbox at /way 77.3, 86.9
- Underwater in the big river between Elwynn Forest and Duskwood.
Locations: Axe 77, 82 / Toolbox 77, 86 (at the boat) / Saw 74, 76
replies: Thank you! Pretty hard to find without coords, honestly. Especially the toolbox.

comments.body: There is a river in front of Soldier Thomas, [b] saw[/b] is beside the second big stone.
replies: I appreciated the comment without coords, thanks!

comments.body: The toolbox is in the boat 77.3 86.9 underwater.
The waterlogged Axe and Saw are fairly easy to find. The coordinates given previously are pretty accurate.  I found the Waterlogged Toolbox by the submerged boat at  77.2, 87.1

One simple paste

[code]/way #1429 76.8, 82.4 Waterlogged Axe
/way #1429 74.3, 76.3 Waterlogged Saw
/way #1429 77.3, 86.9 Waterlogged Toolbox[/code]

While completing this one, make sure you kill the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=248278/croaky#map]elite murloc[/url] in the camp. He's fairly weak, and killing him starts [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=91740/croakys-head]a quest[/url].
